name: Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S.
summary: Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S. provides information technology services in the healthcare sector in Turkey and internationally. The company offers health informatics, digital health transformation, solutions social security, and family and social aid solutions such as healthcare software modules, including consultation management, appointment management, patient record/admission management, emergency management, polyclinic management, interoperability systems, decision support management, material resource and inventory management, fixture and asset management, home health care services management, and remote health information systems. The company also provides software development services, project implementation, and system support. In addition, it offers turnkey project services and develops, sells, and supports ERP products used in both public and private sectors. The company's products include Fonet Hospital Information Management System (HIS), that manages medical, administrative, and financial business processes of health institutions. Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
